title: Australian special forces paid cash for US UAP retrieval operations

tellings.quote: And they told me they'd been involved in retrieval operations.

plain: Members of Australia's special forces say they were paid in cash to take part in American operations to recover crashed unidentified craft. Ross Coulthart, an Australian investigative journalist, says the soldiers themselves told him they had been involved in these retrieval missions. If true, the US recovery effort would reach well beyond American forces.
